name: Kiln-Lighthouse Spit
core_rationale: Northern porcelain-beacon sandspit of Glaze-River Delta at [1, 0] where a thirty-meter cobalt kiln-lighthouse guides river barges through thermal steam banks.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Barge-potters say the cobalt flame inside Kiln-Lighthouse Spit rings like a crystal bell whenever a storm approaches from the outer sea.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A thirty-meter spiral lighthouse of cobalt-blue porcelain rising from a steaming river sandspit.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What sea-lane chart is glazed into the lantern-room floor of Kiln-Lighthouse Spit?

causal_continuity.evidence: Forms the northern beacon spit of Glaze-River Delta along scar-kiln-basin.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Spiral cobalt-blue porcelain lighthouse burning clay oil amidst warm delta steam.
